stage_boundaries.planner: Kafka tasks publication timestamp minus matching inbox publication timestamp; includes observable queue/processing interval
stage_boundaries.writer: Kafka drafts publication timestamp minus matching tasks publication timestamp; includes observable queue/processing interval
stage_boundaries.reviewer: Kafka final publication timestamp minus matching drafts publication timestamp; includes observable queue/processing interval
stage_boundaries.queue_wait_total: max(0, HW9 timings_ms.agent - planner_ms - writer_ms - reviewer_ms); residual after observed stage intervals
stage_boundaries.evaluation: not executed per request; no latency fabricated
stage_boundaries.total: HW9 response latency_ms, with monotonic wall-clock fallback only for failures

percentile_method: linear interpolation on sorted values at index (n-1)*p/100
cache_miss_end_to_end_percentage: p50 stage latency divided by p50 total latency, multiplied by 100
